text:
elaine: :mega: Heads up — midyear all-hands this Wednesday 7/21 at 10:00am PT. Please block your calendar if you haven't already. Recording and slides will be shared after the meeting (link below).

elaine: Quick agenda draft:
- 10:00 — Exec state of the company (2x key metrics + roadmap priorities)
- 10:15 — Product highlights: Dedicated GA + Private pilot updates
- 10:30 — Ops & reliability: recent incident summary + learnings
- 10:40 — People & hiring snapshot / org updates
- 10:50 — Q&A (submit here or drop questions in this thread)

elaine: Submit quick Qs in this thread or via the form: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-midyear-qa (one-line Qs preferred). If you want to ask live, say so and we'll prioritize.

matt: Product note — we’ll demo Dedicated GA perf numbers and a short config walkthrough. Will also call out burst capacity options.

sara: For the incident summary: we’ll link to the postmortem in #incidents and give a 5-min recap of mitigations and the rollout plan for the fix.

kevin: brief ops add — last week’s deploy-induced latency spike was contained; mitigation was hotfix + routing fallback. Postmortem draft is at https://tinyurl.com/redwood-incident-draft, comments welcome.

jen: People ops — quick reminder about the open Q&A office hours after the all-hands (1:1 slots for career/pathing). If you need live captioning or accessibility accommodations, please ping me.

rachel: Request — can we enable live captions for the meeting and record with captions? That would help engineering and folks in APAC. :pray:

elaine: Yep — captions on, recording will include captions. If you need language-specific notes, DM Jen.

ola: Question for the product segment — will Dedicated GA pricing include burst-only plans or is it reserved-only? Adding here so it can be answered in Q&A.

matt: quick reply — we'll cover pricing tiers and burst behavior in the demo; if not fully resolved we’ll follow up in the doc.

rachel: +1 on documenting follow-up answers in the all-hands doc.

elaine: Logistics: join link is on the calendar invite; please arrive a couple minutes early so we can start on time. If you have a sensitive question for execs, mark it private in the form and we'll take it offline.

allhands-bot: :information_source: Reminder: slides + recording will be posted to the #all-hands channel and the shared drive within 24 hours after the meeting.

kevin: FYI — SRE will post a short checklist afterwards for teams affected by the incident (configs to update, verifications to run).

elaine: Thanks all — looking forward. If you have a burning Q, drop it now. :eyes:
